notes.title: OceanCraft Event - It´s getting spookie
notes.content:
With Halloween coming up there are a few special things to experience in OceanCraft!

This event is limited to only happen a week around Halloween from the 24th October to the 2rd November. You will keep all the stuff you collect during the event, but after the 3rd everything will return to normal until Halloween next year, so you better don´t miss it!

If you have spend some time in OceanCraft during Halloween last year most of the content will be familiar to you, but we also added some new things!

[b]Spookie Islands[/b]
Go hunting for the treasure of cursed pirates on spookie islands. Are you brave enough to lift the coffin, or are you too scared of catching a curse?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/3e070bb8072d24fb1cc7d6e7e30f0f66cf08413d.jpg[/img]

[b]Candy[/b]
It´s time to move away from all these healthy vegetables and fresh fish you have been enjoying so far, and start eating the real deal: candy.
There will be small trick-or-treat bags floating around in the water, supplying you with all the sugar you could ever want (don´t ask, how they got there).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/2ac625ca457e85c435d2f2310c6865c46c2ac90b.png[/img]

[b]Jack-O-Lantern[/b]
It´s getting dark at night on your OceanCraft, better craft yourself some lanterns out of the pumpkins you have been growing so far. And of course they also look nice in daylight!
You can get the needed candles from special Halloween airdrops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/23399d01038a8f5c1dda728ae2f97b10327d6773.png[/img]

[b]Witch Hat[/b]
To bewitch all of your friends with your stunning looks, we added a witch hat you can also find in the Halloween airdrops. You can wear this hat like the other hats from the last update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/1a155c0cad10032e5867706515415cd6e7408ddd.png[/img]

Here is a list of the complete season features:

[list]
[*] Candy bonbon
[*] Lollipop
[*] Jack-O-Lantern for crafting and building
[*] Seasonal category in crafting book
[*] Candle (only for crafting Jack-O-Lantern)
[*] Halloween balloon air drops
[*] Floating Halloween candy bag
[*] Halloween witch hat
[*] Big fish wear witch hat
[*] Palms on islands are dead trees
[*] Treasure chest on island is coffin
[/list]

notes.title: Free OceanCraft demo now available on steam
notes.content:
As some of you may know OceanCraft started out as a prototype on the Oculus Quest platform “Sidequest”. You could always download the very first version of OceanCraft there as a free demo.

With all the technical and graphical changes to OceanCraft we decided to update the demo version. This update also opened the opportunity to release the demo version onto other platforms, such as steam.

So, if you have a friend you want to show the game to, or you yourself want to test the game before buying you can now download the free demo version on steam!

The demo can be played cross platform multiplayer with the sidequest demo! Multiplayer between the demo and the full game is not possible.

notes.title: OceanCraft Update 0.8.x – Treasure Hunting
notes.content:
Hallo OceanCrafters,

After months of work and lots of testing, we finally have the next update for you! As announced earlier this year the Theme is “Treasure Hunting” which involves treasure maps, sunken treasures, and an underwater environment.
Gameplay wise this update fills a gap in the middle of the current progress - before you get to build the sail. There is very few new content to the end of the journey. So, if you want to experience the changes fully, we recommend getting your friends together and starting a new game! Though of course you can still play with your old save games.

[h1]Treasure Map[/h1]

The islands hold more secrets than you knew! Each one of them has a hidden treasure just waiting for you to find it. So, use your trusted compass to orient your treasure map to north, compare landmarks and start searching for the right spot. Once you have found it, you can use the new treasure magnet, to lift the chest out of the ground! See who of your friends can get to the treasure first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/6c5225e389f2e44dc6d2521708f56545f2c1a442.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sunken Treasures[/h1]

Deep on the grounds of the ocean there are not only sunken islands, but also sunken treasures waiting for you to find them. Once you see a treasure spot highlighted on the horizon, set sail, or use your new mode of transport the “waterwheel” to get there. You can use your crane to lift the sunken treasure up. We know there are sunken pirate ships, but what else can you find?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/a1d98973b352eee537ebd84d90933433a92936fb.png[/img]

[h1]Underwater Reef[/h1]

In the waters of every island lays a paradise just waiting for you. Use the diving pier to reach the underwater world, enjoy the atmosphere of the coral reef and collect some crafting resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/dbd32d8f4257a4fbc226233581770e6a77109ceb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Character Creator[/h1]

We are finally fulfilling the discord communities wish for beards! Additionally, we added glasses you can wear, more hair colors, and the option to change your appearance in game with the crafting object “Dresser”.

Together with these changes we also made the hats into collectable items. This means whenever you find and wear a hat, it gets added to your collection and you can from then on choose to wear it from your collection.

You can also meet up with different players and exchange hat collections. To add to the fun, we added a whole bunch of new hats. Can you collect them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/2e54d3108ef7277b397b6f715a0e602f95974f26.jpg[/img]

[h1]Player Rights[/h1]

Did you have troubles with other players misbehaving on your OceanCraft? Then we have the solution for you! While you can not make them walk the plank, you can limit their interactions.

You can now decide on a per player basis if they can 1) access chests 2) build new objects onto you OceanCraft 3) destroy objects on your OceanCraft and 4) can grab anything.

Additionally, every chest/crafting table inventory has the option to be locked/set to “private”. A locked chest can only be accessed by the host of the game.

We hope these additional options will make you feel saver, when inviting other people to your OceanCraft. You can use the “Grab anything” right as a visitor mode, where other people can look at what you build, but cannot change anything.

Of course, you still have the option to ban people from your game if they continue to be trouble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/a74cb288a208643f3de98fa09606d2fa433a5726.png[/img]

[b]As always there is a lot more to explore. Here are the full build notes:[/b]

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added glasses as collectable items. They can be found in balloons and chest, like the hats
[*] Added more hats

[*] [b]Added Character Creator (Dresser) into main game[/b]
[list]
[*] change your appearance while on your OceanCraft
[*] added more colors for hair
[*] added beards
[*] added hats category
[*] added glasses category
[/list]
[*] [b]Added underwater reef[/b]
[list]
[*] Reefs can be accessed from islands
[*] Decoration (fish and corals) is randomly generated
[*] Players can find crafting materials
[/list]
[*] [b]Added Sunken Treasures[/b]
[list]
[*] Treasure spots appear once the workbench is built
[*] Sunken Treasures can be lifted with the crane, like islands
[*] There are multiple appearances each with randomly generated decoration
[*] Each Sunken treasure has one chest which contains crafting materials, food, hats and glasses
[/list]
[*] [b]Added Treasure Hunting[/b]
[list]
[*] Each island now contains a treasure chest
[*] Once an island is found the map changes to show the position of the chest
[*] Chests contain crafting materials, food, hats and glasses
[*] Chests can be lifted with the treasure chest magnet
[/list]
[*] [b]Added Tool Treasure chest magnet[/b]
[list]
[*] Magnet can be crafted in the crafting table
[*] When the magnet is pointed at the spot of the treasure chest, it will lift the chest up
[/list]
[*] Added tree plant pot in which coconuts, kiwis and oranges can be planted
[*] Walls now also fit into the 45° floors

[*] [b]Added waterwheel[/b]
[list]
[*] Waterwheel can be crafted from the workbench
[*] Before the sail is accessible players can use the waterwheel to move their OceanCraft
[/list]
[*] [b]Added simple anchor[/b]
[list]
[*] Simple anchor can be crafted from the workbench
[*] Before the better anchor is accessible players can use the simple anchor to stop their OceanCraft
[*] The simple anchor can only be used once
[/list]
[*] [b]Added privacy settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Host now has more control over other players during multiplayer games
[*] The host can change the settings when starting a game and in the crafting book
[*] Default settings are applied to joining players, but every right can be applied on a per player basis
[*] Every chest can be locked by the host. Locked chests can only be accessed by the host
[*] [u]Rights[/u]
[list]
[*] Can interact (This is the extreme settings. Players without it cannot interact with anything in the game)
[*] Can build (Players with this setting can build new things onto the OceanCraft)
[*] Can destroy (Players with this setting can destroy already build things with the hammer)
[*] Can access public chests (Without this setting players cannot use chests. Players with this setting can use chests, unless they are locked by the host)
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Added option to change the rotation speed settings for smooth rotation
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hats are now collectable items. Once the player has found one, it can be found in the character creator
[*] Metal and fabric are no longer exclusively from tiny pirates, but can also be found in sunken treasures
[*] Balloons no longer contain all hats. Some are now in sunken treasures and the island treasure chest
[*] Island spots now only appear once the craftingtable is build
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed lighting in the menu
[*] Fixed problems with water pistol
[*] Fixed problems with lighting sometimes striking in invalid spots
[/list]

notes.title: OceanCraft Patch - You shall not pass
notes.content:
Fixed a problem with kicked players rejoining a game.

Players that were kicked out of a game used to be able to rejoin the game after a time limit had passed. Since players abused this feature to harass others - it has been removed. If a player is now kicked out of a game, there is no way for him to rejoin!

If you have kicked out a friend for fun and want him to rejoin you now need to close the current play session, return to the menu and open it again.

Since we want to support players opening public games for others, but also protect them from harassment, we are planning to add additional privacy settings, so players can choose who can take out items from chests, build new items, destroy already build items and so on.

We are sorry for everyone who had a bad experience.

notes.title: OceanCraft Update 0.7x – Land in sight
notes.content:
We are finally bringing you the update everybody expected and was waiting for the most – Islands.

[h1]Maps[/h1]
Collect bottle messages out of the ocean, to find treasure maps to hidden island. Navigate the sea with the help of your compass and direct your OceanCraft by manipulating the sail. Be ready for what you find, once you have reached the X on your map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/a90b4ef607ec0d66c2ef978bfbbb5a1ddce9d945.png[/img]

[h1]Crane and Anchor[/h1]
All islands in the world of OceanCraft have sunken to the ocean floor, and it is your task to find them and pull them up into the air again. Once you have reached an island, stop you OceanCraft by releasing the anchor. Then you can use a crane, to pull them up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/0bf0bd8cca6943062792427d00e1515bd0ed4923.png[/img]

[h1]Islands[/h1]
The islands you will find are full of riches. Get a pause from fish and potatoes and bite into a rich juicy orange, kiwi or coconut. Try your luck at fishing the new fish out of ponds on the island. Or carefully search for the crafting resources you can collect.
Once you have fully explored and harvested the island, you can go back to your OceanCraft, return the island back to the ocean, pull the anchor back and set sail for your next destination. But carefully consider leaving, each island is unique and once you have released it, you won´t be able to visit it ever again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/6d15afa798f4e57a529589e91b073f37c51e0881.png[/img]

[h1]Blender[/h1]
Are you sick of always drinking the same old distilled water? We have the solution for your: smoothies. Just put whatever food you want into your brand-new blender (yes even fish). Pull the lever and in a matter of seconds you have a more or less delicious smoothie. And we haven´t even told you the best thing yet, they not only reduce your thirst, but also your hunger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/4ced24005bf0fbd86fe1cf786c8e14d8e382d892.png[/img]

As always beside the big main update features we of course have lots of small changes and features:

[/list]
[*] Added Singleplayer mode (offline ingame, but still needs internet connection in start screen)

[*] Map shows location and direction of the OceanCraft
[*] Map shows location of the island
[*] Map gets inactive once the island was found -> Players can find new map for next island
[*] New item compass to help with orientation
[/list]
[*] [b]Sailing[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can rotate the sail to change the direction
[*] Players can lift up/down the sail to change the driving speed
[*] Multiple sails interact with each other (but don´t give a big advantage in speed)
[/list]
[*] [b]Islands[/b]
[list]
[*] Finding:
[list]
[*] Players see islands in the world as shining spots
[*] Players can find islands with the help of the map
[*] Players can lift islands up out of the ocean with the crane
[*] After exploring the island player put it back under the sea
[/list]
[*] Content
[list]
[*] New food for eating and grilling
[list]
[*] Coconut
[*] Orange
[*] Kiwi
[*] Pond Fish 1
[*] Pond Fish 2
[/list]
[*] Randomly generated island environment containing grass, rocks, sand, trees and ponds
[*] Crafting Resources
[list]
[*] Metal
[*] Sand (can be used to craft glass)
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*] [b]Crane[/b]
[list]
[*] Can lift islands up und down
[*] Indicates if it is placed correctly (needs to face open water), if an island is under it, and if the player has to move it up or down
[*] Players need to turn the crank to use it
[/list]
[*] [b]Anchor[/b]
[list]
[*] Completely stops the OceanCraft
[*] Has quick release
[*] Anchor can be cranked up again
[/list]
[*] [b]Blender[/b]
[list]
[*] All food can be put in the blender and mixed to create smoothies
[*] Smoothies can be filled in bottles
[/list]
[*] [b]Bottle[/b]
[list]
[*] Bottles can be crafted
[*] Bottles can be filled with smoothies
[*] Players can fill and drink out of bottles three times
[*] Smoothies in bottles help with hunger and thirst
[/list]
[*] Added buildable door (wall with door) in wood and metal optic
[*] Added buildable fishing nets, which collect things out of the ocean on their own
[*] Added two new building tables, craftingtable and craftinglab for crafting new advanced items
[*] Added new tool advanced hook, which shoots a lot farther

notes.title: OceanCraft Update 0.6.x - Be careful and keep crafting
notes.content:
Hi Guys, we have the next big update for you!

[h1]Thunder and Lightning[/h1]
Look out! The weather will not always stay nice and sunny, Now and then an angry rain cloud will make it´s way to your OceanCraft. While the rain might be nice and refreshing, the lightning is not!
Stay safe, keep away from high places and prepare to put out some fires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/a6396b0824cca1a58274a1403fbfcef07a579d04.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tiny Pirates[/h1]
You are not the only ones enjoining a nice day out on the ocean. These waters are home to a fleet of particularly tiny and aggressive pirates. They will sing sea shanties, drink impossible amounts and bombard you with flaming cannonballs out of their cute little tiny cannons.
Sink them, before they sink you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/58a51de2a89eb255c4f5727580191ca09072250f.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Crafting System[/h1]
While we liked the crafting book and will keep it for some items, we decided to change to a system of crafting tables. 
Select your chosen recipe, collect all necessary ingredient and start building!
Everybody on your OceanCraft can add to the needed items and the tables are height adjustable, so tiny and huge people can enjoy this new system together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/8d7d6e3c4d4d06534d62f2e50778ef8e3eabb2ea.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fire![/h1]
Your OceanCraft burns! Put it out fast, or the fire will spread and destroy everything you have build so far! It´s a good thing you are surrounded by water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/e98096a045c142aa60f616259625c2e303494cd5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Water pistol[/h1]
We have a new tool for you. It´s great for watering your plants, or friends! Maybe it even helps with putting out fires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/4f0909d0091aeca5365ecc9ac5032e8329f9d616.jpg[/img]

[h1]Winter is coming[/h1]
Winter has come to your OceanCraft. Build a snowman, have epic snowball fights, exchange presents and enjoy all the cookies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/7f6bc0fb9e16f7b6e9e3f15578a5d39759191070.jpg[/img]

notes.title: OceanCraft Event - Trick or Treat
notes.content:
With Halloween coming up, we added a secret little something into the last update!

This event is limited to only happen a week around Halloween from the 27th October to the 3rd November. You will keep all the stuff you collect during the event, but after the 3rd everything will return to normal until Halloween next year, so you better don´t miss it!

[b]Candy[/b]
It´s time to move away from all these healthy vegetables and fresh fish you have been enjoying so far, and start eating the real deal: candy.
There will be small trick-or-treat bags floating around in the water, supplying you with all the sugar you could ever want (don´t ask, how they got there).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/2ac625ca457e85c435d2f2310c6865c46c2ac90b.png[/img]

[b]Jack-O-Lantern[/b]
It´s getting dark at night on your OceanCraft, better craft yourself some lanterns out of the pumpkins you have been growing so far. And of course they also look nice in daylight!
You can get the needed candles from special Halloween airdrops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/23399d01038a8f5c1dda728ae2f97b10327d6773.png[/img]

[b]Witch Hat[/b]
To bewitch all of your friends with your stunning looks, we added a witch hat you can also find in the Halloween airdrops. You can wear this hat like the other hats from the last update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/1a155c0cad10032e5867706515415cd6e7408ddd.png[/img]

Here is a list of the complete season features:

[list]
[*] Candy bonbon
[*] Lollipop
[*] Jack-O-Lantern for crafting and building
[*] Seasonal category in crafting book
[*] Candle (only for crafting Jack-O-Lantern)
[*] Halloween balloon air drops
[*] Floating Halloween candy bag
[*] Halloween witch hat 
[/list]

notes.title: OceanCraft Update 0.5.x - Smile for the camera
notes.content:
Hi guys,

we are still working hard on the next big feature. So to bridge the time we decided to give you some new stuff to play with and one of our favorite developer tools: the ingame camera.

[b]The Camera[/b]
We have been using it for quite some time to create all the nice ingame shots you have seen so far (like the pictures in this announcement) . And of course we put some work into it, so you get a shiny nice version, not the janky developer version we worked with.

There is exactly one camera per oceancraft. It is shared between you and all of your friends on board. Everyone can access it equaly from their inventory, so play nice and share with each other!

The pictures work like any other screenshots you are used to making and will show up in your Steam screenshots of OceanCraft. So you can share the pictures of your playsession with your friends, or online.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/3f4eac3d097c81f62d279cc668f21fa6e61f9af6.jpg[/img]

[b]Hats[/b]
Additionally, to make all the future pictures you are going to take even nicer, we added some hats you can find ingame and wear around on your head. So you can be a fearless viking, a dreaded pirate or a shiny unicorn!

As long as you keep them on your head, the hats will stay with your character, even on your other oceancrafts! Hats in your inventory, will of course stay inside the inventory of their prospective savefile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/be68e2bdd4b5d01e665786892774234ac877043c.png[/img]

[b]Triangular Platforms[/b]
For all of you building amazing OceanCrafts we also added triangular floors and ceilings, so you can build in even more interesting shapes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/6d4167151a1e7c4692b930071b6e2b08a83ad413.jpg[/img]

There are also some minor changes and additional features we are shipping with this update. Your can read the full list of the new features below:

[list]
[*] Can Grab out multiple items from inventory (hold trigger while grabbing)
[*] Added triangular platforms + triangular floors (rotate via stick)
[*] Added camera
[list]
[*] save pictures to steam profile or application folder on oculus
[*] take picture by pressing button on camera
[*] take picture by looking at the camera and waving (3 second delay)
[*] preview picture and save or discard
[*] get camera from button in inventory
[*] only ever one camera per OceanCraft
[/list]
[*] Added possibility to build some items on tables (fishbowl + sunflower)
[*] Added small table
[*] Detatched fishbowl from small table
[*] Secret seasonal items         
[*] Added item chair
[*] Grabed vegetables from plants will no longer spawn in inventory, but stay in player hand
[*] Added Hats
[list]
[*] Place and remove hat from player head
[*] Added hat balloon, which drops a random hat when shot
[*] Cap 01
[*] Cap 02
[*] Cap 03
[*] Cap 04
[*] Cap 05
[*] Hat shark
[*] Hat squid
[*] Hat unicorn
[*] Hat pirates
[*] Hat pirates_blackbeard
[*] Hat pirates_navy
[*] Hat viking_grunt
[*] Hat viking_warrior
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: OceanCraft Update 0.4.x - Locomotion and Tasks
notes.content:
[h1]New Locomotion[/h1]
A lot of people kept asking us for different movement methods in OceanCraft 
finally the waiting has an end! 

You can now choose between different movement and rotations options:
Smooth locomotion, smooth rotation, snap rotation, teleport with snap turning

Additionally we added a dominant hand feature - because you can't always be right...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/cae0d4835bf65fcf8f08c9893b4cf2c1c2ad0cc9.jpg[/img]



[h1]The Dolphin[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39884211/4b96c1d7294f6bc0b9c160fb3a1f67501ed43471.jpg[/img]
This cute buddy helps you through your first steps in the world of OceanCraft and tells you how to move and how to use the hook.

Additionally we introduced Tasks/Missions to guide through most of the possibilities you already have within OceanCraft - they are optional ... so ignorance is ok, too! 



New Stuff in version 0.4.x
--------------------------
+ Added new Locomotion methods: Smooth locomotion, smooth rotation, snap rotation, teleport with snap turning
+ Added dominant hand features
+ Added tutorial buddy "the dolphin"
+ Changed tutorial system to tasks 
+ New Tool selection - circular menu when holding button 
+ New Tool selection - quick change to hand and last tool when short pressing button
+ Removed special tool slots in inventory
+ New Missions / Tasks / Tutorials in menu
+ Reworked Menu UI
+ Improved placement behaviour (specially for stairs)
+ Added sounds to grill and purifier
+ Changed Input System / Improvements for Knuckles users

Fixes
--------------------------
+ Fixed issue #27 "Duplication Glitch"
+ Fixed issue #22 - Wood in water purifier renewed after re-building
+ Fixed issue #23 "Water boiling (again)"
+ Fixed issue #26 "I copied someone's island"
+ Fixed issue where destroyed stairs did not return box
+ Fixed issue where item rested on crate instead of getting into
+ Fixed hook speed differences on different platforms
+ Fixed some networking problems.. now: less disconnects
+ Fixed default selected region
